A digital divide is mentioned in a speech; no rural programme or rural and urban figures are stated.

facts.fact: Prime Minister Sama Lukonde says the national digital plan begun on the President's initiative in 2019, built on four pillars (infrastructure, content, uses, governance and regulation), carries the digital development strategy to the 2025 horizon.

The Prime Minister inaugurated the first national data centre, built for the Finance ministry and its revenue agencies under a Huawei contract signed in December 2017 and amended in 2020, holding 54 servers of 1,278 TB.
